item.title: Kyuuketsuki no Libra
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Onomatope*
  • 発売日: 2015-10-30
  • スコア: 6.37/10 (616 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 吸血姫のリブラ
  • 英語名: Kyuuketsuki no Libra

别名

  • 吸血姬的天秤座

あらすじ

Kusanagi Shuuma was living a life of an ordinary boy until one day he got suddenly abducted by one of the three vampire ringleaders - Iris Pumila. She revealed to him the secret of his ancestors - that he has vampire progenitor’s blood coursing through his veins and that it is her destiny to awaken his true nature. Fortunately, Shuuma was able to escape from Pumila at that time and return to his ordinary daily life, but as a consequence of his encounter with her - his body has radically changed and he became a half-vampire. As a side effect of his sudden change, Shuuma obtained superhuman strenght and vampire’s vitality but he also started having spontaneous vampiric impulses that are calling for him to suck blood of living creatures.

item.title: Sakura No Reply
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Onomatope*
  • 発売日: 2012-05-25
  • スコア: 6.93/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 桜ノーリプライ
  • 英語名: Sakura No Reply

あらすじ

When Ichigo was small, he lived with his grandmother on a small island surrounded by the ocean and mountains. Due to his parent’s work, he moved away, leaving behind his sickly imouto Minto and close friends. He did not have any plans for his future, but then he was chosen to be part of a student exchange with their sister school. So he returned to the island and reunited with his now grown-up imouto and childhood friends. On this small island where the sakura do not bloom, will the hope and love in their hearts blossom?

item.title: Mecha-con!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Onomatope*
  • 発売日: 2011-04-08
  • スコア: 7.26/10 (102 人評価)
  • 日本語名: めちゃ婚！
  • 英語名: Mecha-con!

别名

  • mecyacon

あらすじ

This is the debut game for onomatope*. A sudden change in law by the government ten years ago decreed that rich men must have multiple wives and father lots of children. Haruki’s parents passed away in a traffic accident and he inherited the family wealth while continuing to manage the Sakurajima business group. Even though he hasn’t had a girlfriend before, he now must propose to those girls that are closest to him.
